## Cerebras Stock Plunges 14% After-Hours Following Second Post-IPO Earnings Report

A 14% AH drop on the second post-IPO print is a significant credibility event for CBRS; the key read is whether this reflects a structural ramp challenge or a timing gap between demand signals and recognized revenue — the answer shapes whether this is a dip to buy or a guide to discount.

- CBRS fell 14% in after-hours trading after releasing its second quarterly earnings report since its IPO.
- The magnitude of the move signals a meaningful gap between reported results and investor expectations.
- This is consistent with the same-day Seeking Alpha cluster flagging a Q2 miss against expectations.
- The post-IPO timing makes the reaction a credibility event, not merely a quarterly miss.
